articles.title: Trump's dramatic plane swap hints at personal stakes of Iran war
articles.description: It marks another striking episode in the turbulent history of his relationship with Iran, writes the BBC's Anthony Zurcher.

articles.title: Trump says he switched planes after Nato summit because of possible threat
articles.description: But the president says the jet he boarded instead was at "greater risk" than the decoy Air Force One.

articles.title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
articles.description: US Central Command says its helicopter hit the engine room of a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.

articles.title: New Zealand PM survives second leadership challenge ahead of election
articles.description: Christopher Luxon says he has "full support" of his party, after a vote of confidence 12 weeks before a general election.

articles.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
articles.description: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed seven people - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.

articles.title: British couple jailed in Iran end hunger strike after several months, family says
articles.description: A British couple jailed in Iran over alleged spying have ended a three-month-long hunger strike against their sentence, their son has said.
